### CANDIDATE DETAIL
#### 1. ceroid lipofuscinosis, neuronal, 6A  —  Tier 1 — Definitive / Highly Plausible  (fitness 0.783)
**Link type:** shared causal gene (HGNC:2077)

**Proposed mechanism:** CLN6 (HGNC:2077) —DISRUPTS→ Lysosomal protein trafficking and degradation (GO:0005767); Lysosomal protein trafficking and degradation (GO:0005767) —LEADS_TO→ Seizures (HP:0001250); Lysosomal protein trafficking and degradation (GO:0005767) —LEADS_TO→ Visual impairment (HP:0000505); Lysosomal protein trafficking and degradation (GO:0005767) —LEADS_TO→ Cognitive impairment (HP:0001249). Loss-of-function mutations in CLN6 disrupt normal lysosomal protein trafficking and degradation, leading to the accumulation of autofluorescent storage material and subsequent neurodegeneration, manifesting as seizures, visual impairment, and cognitive decline in both NCL6A and NCL6B.

**How to falsify it:** Identification of a pathogenic variant in CLN6 that confers a gain-of-function or dominant-negative effect in either disease, or a complete lack of overlap in affected cellular pathways. _(variant: rs72551337)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared molecular pathology in CLN6-related neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis can facilitate the development of targeted therapies that address the common downstream consequences of CLN6 dysfunction, potentially benefiting patients with both NCL6A and NCL6B.
